prompt: fish shell IFS empty string effect command substitution
answer:
In fish, setting `IFS` to an empty string disables line splitting in command substitutions.

```fish
begin
    set -l IFS
    set data (cat data.txt)
end
```

Here, the output of `cat data.txt` is assigned to `data` without being split into an array by newlines.

Normally, fish command substitutions split output on newlines—not on spaces or tabs. To split on another delimiter, use `string split`, `string split0`, or `string collect`.
